_comment: APT's own pseudo entries — computed filter rows, not game text. Recognisable
by the TRAILING SPACE in the matcher string (not in the ref): '# Crafted
Modifiers ', '+#% total to Fire Resistance '. They have no counterpart in the
game data at all, so the generator cannot derive them; they are maintained by
hand HERE, next to it, and go into the same coverage check.
The trailing space carries meaning and belongs in the value.
126 entries, the same number in the local and in the current upstream set —
they practically never change. Keys are the ENGLISH matcher string, values are
one entry per language code. 'ru' and 'ko' are taken verbatim from the sets APT
itself ships, which is what makes them the yardstick for the cross-check; 'de'
is hand written against the German client's own vocabulary (client_strings.js).
A pseudo matcher without an entry for the target language produces no matcher
and is listed in full by the generator.
